description: Defines the StreamProvider class for media remoting, including nested MediaStream class, handling demuxer streams, RPC messaging, and Mojo IPC integration.

classes.name: StreamProvider
classes.description: Media remoting stream provider implementing Demuxer, managing media streams and RPC communication.

classes.name: StreamProvider::MediaStream
classes.description: DemuxerStream implementation for media remoting, handling data pipe, RPC messaging, and buffer management.

methods.name: StreamProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream provider with receiver controller and media task runner.

methods.name: ~StreamProvider
methods.description: Destructor, only called via Destroy().

methods.name: GetAllStreams
methods.description: Returns all demuxer streams.

methods.name: GetDisplayName
methods.description: Returns display name of the demuxer.

methods.name: GetDemuxerType
methods.description: Returns the type of demuxer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the demuxer with host and status callback.

methods.name: AbortPendingReads
methods.description: Aborts any pending read operations.

methods.name: StartWaitingForSeek
methods.description: Starts waiting for a seek operation at specified time.

methods.name: CancelPendingSeek
methods.description: Cancels a pending seek at specified time.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Performs seek to specified time with callback.

methods.name: IsSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the demuxer.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the stream.

methods.name: GetTimelineOffset
methods.description: Returns the timeline offset.

methods.name: GetMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns memory usage.

methods.name: GetContainerForMetrics
methods.description: Returns media container info for metrics.

methods.name: OnEnabledAudioTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles change in enabled audio tracks.

methods.name: OnSelectedVideoTrackChanged
methods.description: Handles change in selected video track.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets playback rate (no-op here).

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the stream provider, called via DeleteHelper.

methods.name: OnReceivedRpc
methods.description: Handles received RPC messages.

methods.name: OnAcquireDemuxer
methods.description: Handles RPC message to acquire demuxer.

methods.name: InitializeDataPipe
methods.description: Initializes data pipe for media streams.

methods.name: OnAudioStreamCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of audio stream.

methods.name: OnVideoStreamCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of video stream.

methods.name: OnAudioStreamInitialized
methods.description: Handles audio stream initialization.

methods.name: OnVideoStreamInitialized
methods.description: Handles video stream initialization.

methods.name: CompleteInitialize
methods.description: Completes initialization process.
